_meta.name: sic_industry_map
_meta.warning: This is an UNAPPROVED, engineer-authored draft crosswalk from SEC SIC codes to Visentix industry_id codes (IND-xx). It is NOT applied to organization.industry_id by the sec_edgar importer. An expert must review and approve every range before this map may feed profiling (F03) or any benchmark cohorting. See db/migrations/0025_sic_industry_map.sql and the F02 EDGAR change report.
_meta.industry_id_source: IND-xx codes per db/migrations/0014 comment; industry_taxonomy table does not yet exist live, so industry_id is a free-text code here.
_meta.range_semantics: Each row covers the inclusive 4-digit SIC range [sic_low, sic_high]. The requested (sic_code, industry_id, mapped_by) triple is expressed as a range per row to avoid seeding thousands of single-code rows; the connector expands ranges at load time.

ranges.notes: SIC 52-59 retail trade (building materials, general merchandise, food, apparel, furniture, eating/drinking, misc retail).
SIC 7370-7379 computer programming, prepackaged software (7372), data processing / hosting.
SIC 80 health services (offices/clinics, hospitals, labs, home health).
SIC 6200-6299 security & commodity brokers, dealers, exchanges.
SIC 6700-6799 holding & other investment offices (excludes 6500-6599 real estate, intentionally unmapped in this draft).
SIC 8200-8299 educational services (schools, colleges, libraries, vocational).
SIC 7800-7999 motion pictures, amusement & recreation services.
